agent.usage_reconciliation: not performed; gate before dispatch, no credential reads or provider calls in qualification

filter_weighting: equal across six scalar filters; unfiltered is separate control

latency.allocation_hardware: compatible x86_64; record node and CPU, no arbitrary node pinning
latency.bootstrap: 20000 paired hierarchical draws: allocation then vector group; keep filters, arm labels and epochs paired
latency.endpoint: arithmetic mean complete request on persistent reader, including feature collection, policy evaluation, execution, continuation and decoding
latency.identical_code_control: 90% two-sided paired hierarchical interval for each family/filter A/B mean ratio wholly inside [0.98,1.02]; every relevant control must pass
latency.primary_interval: one-sided upper 97.5% percentile bound for each of two ratios (Bonferroni family .05)
latency.retry: replace at most two independently documented infrastructure-invalid allocations with unchanged code; retain all returns; no statistical optional stopping
latency.schedule: 14-label Williams rows, mirrored epochs; query order seeded independently, mirrored A/B, filter order rotated
latency.secondary_per_filter: Holm adjusted one-sided comparisons across 12 scalar-filter contrasts; descriptive unfiltered/other comparisons

recall.insufficient_eligible: required_count=min(k,eligible_count); denominator=required_count; zero-eligible recall=1 with empty output
recall.loss_probability_bound: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson; individual alpha .05 and simultaneous alpha .05/7
recall.ties: exact SQL FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES; up to k unique eligible results at or below the kth exact distance, tolerance 1e-6

selection.agent_choice: lowest complete-request mean among quality-eligible new proposals; ties within 1% choose fewer comparisons then fewer clauses then canonical hash
selection.fallback: native640; record negative selection and no successful agent claim
selection.native_choice: lowest complete-request mean among quality-eligible grid candidates; ties within 1% choose higher ef then canonical hash
selection.simple_choice: lowest complete-request mean among quality-eligible fixed/turnover candidates; ties within 1% choose later checkpoint then stricter turnover then canonical hash
